text: Extracts data from REST APIs, SQL databases, cloud storage, and Python data structures
quote: dlt extracts data from REST APIs, SQL databases, cloud storage, Python data structures, and many more

text: Infers schemas, normalizes data, and unnests nested structures automatically
quote: dlt infers schemas and data types, normalizes the data, and handles nested data structures.

text: Supports many built-in destinations and lets you add custom destinations for reverse-ETL pipelines
quote: dlt supports a variety of popular destinations and has an interface to add custom destinations to create reverse ETL pipelines.

text: Automates pipeline maintenance via incremental loading, schema evolution, and schema/data contracts
quote: dlt automates pipeline maintenance with incremental loading, schema evolution, and schema and data contracts.

text: Lets you query loaded data with Python, SQL, dataframe expressions, or Ibis and visualize it in Marimo notebooks
quote: dlt supports Python and SQL data access, transformations and supports pipeline inspection and visualizing data in Marimo Notebooks.

text: pipeline.dataset() lets you query results as records, Pandas frames, or Arrow tables via SQL/Ibis/dataframe expressions

text: dltHub CLI and Web UI let you monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures

text: dbt generator analyzes pipeline schema and auto-generates staging and fact dbt models

text: AI assistants can be turned into expert dlt pipeline developers across 11,200+ REST API sources

text: Merges new data into destinations via merge_key/primary_key, deduplicating and upserting records

text: Automatically infers initial schema and handles subsequent schema changes without breaking pipelines
quote: dlt automatically infers the initial schema for your first pipeline run... dlt handles these schema changes, enabling you to adapt to changes without losing velocity.

text: You can switch destinations without modifying the pipeline code itself
quote: This approach is especially useful when switching between destinations without modifying the actual pipeline code.

text: Offers a collection of verified sources developed and maintained by the dlt team and community

text: Declarative configuration defines REST API endpoints, relationships, pagination, and authentication

text: Supports all SQLAlchemy dialects including Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, and more

text: Agents can ship production pipelines on dltHub-run infrastructure, with every run logged and auditable
quote: Any engineer on your team can ship production data, with agents doing the work on infra we run. Every run is logged and auditable.

text: Incremental loading loads and deduplicates only new or changed records instead of full reloads

text: SQL Database source can load via SQLAlchemy, PyArrow, pandas, or ConnectorX backends

text: Loads JSONL, CSV, and Parquet files from cloud storage, SFTP, or local filesystem

text: GitHub Actions guide lets you run pipelines headlessly in CI with a free tier

text: Ships with 8000+ pre-built source connectors

text: REST API source extracts data from any REST API

text: Provides end-to-end cross-database compatibility for dlt-to-dbt pipelines
quote: End-to-end cross-db compatibility for dlt→dbt pipelines.

quote: Schedule lineage-aware pipeline runs with agents, all in Python
